  "prompt": "Optimize the bwd_kernel_causal Triton kernel for AMD MI355X (gfx950, CDNA4).

Input shapes: batch=8, num_q_heads=64, num_k_heads=8, head_dim=128, seq_len=4096, BF16.
Currently takes 16.2% of total GPU time (2660ms per training iteration).
Called 192 times per training iteration (27 layers x forward/backward).

The kernel name in profiler is: bwd_kernel_causal_BLOCK_M1_32_BLOCK_N1_128_BLOCK_M2_128_BLOCK_N2_32_BLK_SLICE_FACTOR_2_HEAD_DIM_128

Goals: (1) maximize throughput on gfx950, (2) optimal block sizes for 304 CUs,
(3) minimize register pressure, (4) vectorized loads for HBM3e bandwidth.
Return optimized kernel with same function signature.
Write output to the output directory.",
